ranked_ideas.name: All-head counterfactual quality-cost policy improvement
ranked_ideas.hypothesis: A frozen-backbone same-prefill head improves quality-cost Pareto using sparse counterfactual feedback on its own visited states, beyond optimized Native and same-budget imitation/standard cost-sensitive controls
ranked_ideas.outputs: four original actions only; arguments and FINAL generated by frozen Qwen
ranked_ideas.online_fallback: existing BC head only for unsupported state/action; no default Native fallback
ranked_ideas.labels: Q^(pi_k,g,H) from current frozen head rollout states, candidate first actions and same pi_k suffix; F1/EM/support/error and separate cost; not Q*
ranked_ideas.loss: question-weighted linear quality/cost ridge regression (primary beta1) compared with same-data hard best-action/cost-sensitive CE; quality-preserving train-target cost preference; BC coverage anchor
ranked_ideas.policy_iteration: freeze pi_k; collect own-state branches; fit pi_k+1; autonomous whole-episode rollout; only then consider fresh pi_k+1 collection; no mixing conditional Q labels without policy identity
ranked_ideas.cross_fit: 4atomicfamilyconnected-componentfolds;18train/6audit; BC base already trained on24 so conditional incremental-learning diagnostic, not fresh generalization
ranked_ideas.gate: >=4questions alternative deltaF1>=0.25;>=2nonFINAL; autonomous OOF BC-relative F1sum>0,exactgains-losses>=2,positive>=2folds,lostexact<=1; compare actualPareto toNfast and same-budgetcontrols
ranked_ideas.second_cycle: not automatic; at most one separately considered next cycle; compare uniform branch-state allocation vs observable failure/margin allocation at equal budget with>=50%uniform component
ranked_ideas.failure: no learnable gap, format-only gain, simple/same-data baseline tie, family concentration, or Pareto domination => stop strong paper direction and preserve system optimization
ranked_ideas.latency_caveat: all-head control preserves architecture that can save selector decoding, but changed trajectory/optimized Native may remove measured speed advantage; no promised26.8%/20% saving
ranked_ideas.single_intervention_status: optional causal/target diagnostic only, explicitly rejected as flagship

ranked_ideas.name: Budgeted counterfactual state allocation

ranked_ideas.hypothesis: Outcome-blind failure/boundary coverage improves all-head policy more than uniform branching or cost-matched Native imitation coverage
ranked_ideas.inputs: pi_k rollout public state,empty/repetition,BC action margin
ranked_ideas.labels_and_loss: same downstream outcome/cost targets and policy learner asH1; acquisition benefit measured by question-family whole-episode improvement
ranked_ideas.initial_acquisition: predefined mixed heuristic,>=50%uniform,not another tiny-data neural head
ranked_ideas.gate: vsuniform exactnetgain>=2 or F1>=0.03,no costregression,>=2positivefolds,and beatBCcoverage;pilotinvestment criterion only

ranked_ideas.name: Read-candidate generation-value selection

ranked_ideas.inputs: same-prefill final hidden+already observed candidate snippet/body span hidden; ID is pointer address, not assumed to encode subsequent text
